description: What a Creator allows AI to do with their name, image, likeness, voice, movement and signature, in words, with links to the machine-readable HCS 1.0 declaration. A record with no declaration has set no terms: treat that as unknown, never as permission.

sprk_id.description: The record's SPRK ID, e.g. SPRK-00000001. The number alone is accepted.

name: get_ai_consent
title: Read a Creator's AI consent
